cohort: 400 primigravidae women: 100 with PCOS and android obesity, 100 with android obesity and no PCOS, 100 with PCOS and gynoid obesity, and 100 with gynoid obesity and no PCOS
finding: Pregnant women with android obesity, both with and without PCOS, had higher rates of insulin resistance, dyslipidemia, and inflammatory markers compared to those with gynoid obesity, and experienced more late pregnancy complications.
